schema.worker_options: Original settings, plus duration=(original_full_T+0.25)/25; full/prefix10/prefix17 otherwise unchanged
schema.fixed_target_provenance: Baseline request ID/body SHA, integer T, codec frame rate, duration argument, decoded sample count
future_runtime_assertions: Full-fixed sanity arm all132 body hashes equal prior full arm before any crop arm launches
schema.optional_additional_instrumentation: Record actual model GenerationTask.target_lens; not currently measured or an enforced gate

pitfalls: The required_gates strings in config are declarations; the controller must actually enforce full-arm hash equality and stop before cropped arms on any mismatch.
Optional actual integer GenerationTask instrumentation would strengthen evidence; it has not been measured and is not a current gate.
The 0.2-second padding rule is valid only with this pinned helper and postoff/no inserted pauses; do not apply it to trimming, chunking or other codecs.
Duration overrides speed upstream and creates a derived speed_list for chunking. These targets stay short and must be asserted to take the short iterative path.
Quarter-frame interior values are intentional, not literal output duration. Do not use padded WAV duration as the duration argument or remove the quarter-frame guard.
Do not change request order, sampler seed, reference registration, source, codec or hidden worker state when checking the full-fixed sanity arm.
